data.desc: Purple Biotech Ltd. (NASDAQ/TASE: PPBT) is a biotechnology company developing a next-generation immunotherapy platform designed to maximize anti-cancer potency while minimizing toxicity. The Company is focused on advancing CAPTN-3 - a platform of masked tri-specific antibodies that simultaneously target tumors while engaging both T cells and NK cells. Capping technology is designed to confine immune activation to the tumor microenvironment and, based on preclinical data, to expand the therapeutic window compared to conventional T-cell engagers. The platform's lead candidate, IM1240, is advancing toward the clinic, and its second candidate, IM1305, is in preclinical development. The Company is headquartered in Rehovot, Israel.
